## 5. Population and applicability

Eligibility uses facts known only after delivery: a recorded live birth, a singleton birth, and a recorded birth weight between 1 and 6 kg. This is the usual way to define the outcome, but it means the model's population is pregnancies that ended in a weighed singleton live birth, not every woman seen at a second visit. A pregnancy that ends in a stillbirth, a multiple birth or an unrecorded weight is outside what the model has learned, and the limitations of every report say so.
